semiconductor_relevance: High — Koyo Technos specializes in semiconductor inspection probe cards and high-current probes, which are critical for testing and measuring semiconductor devices.
summary: Koyo Technos develops advanced electrical inspection solutions for semiconductors and printed circuit boards, focusing on narrow-pitch probe cards and high-current probes. Their technology supports multiple device under test (DUT) inspections, enabling efficient testing for high-performance applications.
capabilities: Narrow-pitch probe cards with 20μ pin diameter
High-current probes for up to 1000 amperes
